technical-summary: Ships the bf16_i8 KV cache (rad0038, already in serving-core) as two named configs: qwen27b-tp3-int8-556-long-bf16i8 (818,896 tokens; decode equals bf16, first token of a 100K prompt fastest of fp8/bf16/bf16_i8, needles 18 of 18) and the non-default flashnext-4gpu-bf16i8 at 4 sessions (at the production 8 sessions the engine card is 5.47 GB short at admission); fp8 at 8 sessions stays the Flash-Next default. Adds the needle probe tool, the evidence page with the ABBA TP3 data and the Flash-Next production-layout parity (helpers, live policy, two launches, the second replaying), requalification text on the existing promotion record, a corrected recipes comment, and the ENG06 status.
user-summary-candidate: A bf16 key / int8 value KV cache is now available as a named config for the 27B on three cards and, at 4 sessions, for Flash-Next.
